en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Boe is a name, probably a girl's, given her sex in the 'фустанче' exchange (my reading). 'Лудо' is an affectionate address, rendered 'you fool'.

lines.cyr: - Фати се Бое мори на оро,
lines.lat: - Fati se Boe mori na oro,

lines.en: the dance does not look right without you,
the girls are crying, Boe, for you.

lines.cyr: - Како да се фатам, лудо, на оро,
lines.lat: - Kako da se fatam, ludo, na oro,
lines.en: - How can I join the dance, you fool,
when I have no little dress, you fool,
no little belt for my slim waist?
- Join the dance, Boe, hey, dance,

lines.cyr: јас ќе ти купам, Бое, фустанче,
lines.lat: jas ḱe ti kupam, Boe, fustanče,
lines.en: I will buy you a little dress, Boe,
and a little belt for your slim waist.
